home_dir.label: Home folder
home_dir.info: Folder storing all the input data and where the outputs will be stored. Leave blank if you want to use absolute paths.

projections_csv.label: Projections csv
projections_csv.info: CSV file path storing the water balance calculated from GCMs.

validation_dataset_csv.label: Validation dataset
validation_dataset_csv.info: CSV file path of a dataset to be used as validation for the GCMs. This dataset is obtained from field data or remote sensing calculations of water balance.

spei_csv.label: SPEI csv
spei_csv.info: File path of the calculated SPEI

dry_events_csv.label: Drought events csv
dry_events_csv.info: FIle path of the drought calculated events.

dry_events_count_csv.label: Drought events count csv
dry_events_count_csv.info: Count of the drought event calculated from Drought events csv

gcm_eval_csv.label: GCMs validation csv
gcm_eval_csv.info: File path of the GCMs validation csv

copula_analysis_csv.label: Copula csv
copula_analysis_csv.info: File path of the csv to store the Copula analysis results.

execute_spei.label: Execute SPEI
execute_spei.info: Sets if SPEI needs to be calculated or read from a file previoulsy calculated.

execute_ks_test.label: Execute KS
execute_ks_test.info: Sets if Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) needs to be calculated or read from a file previoulsy calculated.

execute_count.label: Count events
execute_count.info: Sets if drought events needs to be calculated or read from a file previoulsy calculated.

execute_copula.label: Execute Copula
execute_copula.info: Sets if the Copula analysis needs to be calculated or read from a file previoulsy calculated.

reference_scenario.label: Reference scenario
reference_scenario.info: Reference scenario to be used as reference to fit the SPEI distribution and compute the historical return interval times.

water_balance_col.label: Water balance column
water_balance_col.info: Column in the water balance input csv that stores the water balance values to be used for SPEI calculation. Default: water_balance

spatial_unit_col.label: Spatial unit column
spatial_unit_col.info: Column in the Projections csv and Validation dataset storing the spatial unit (e.g. water basins, NUTS2) for which the water balance in the Projections and Validation datasets have been calculated.

spatial_units.label: Spatial units (optional)
spatial_units.info: Spatial units to which the analysis shall be limited. If left blank, the analysis will be run for all the spatial units.

spei_indices.label: SPEI scale
spei_indices.info: SPEI scales (months) to be calculated (e.g. 3, 6, 12 months)

spei_threshold.label: SPEI threshold
spei_threshold.info: SPEI value below which a month is considered drought (typically -1, -1.5)

ref_start_year.label: Reference start year
ref_start_year.info: Starting year defining the reference period for the SPEI and return periods calculations.

ref_end_year.label: Reference end year
ref_end_year.info: Last year defining the reference period for the SPEI and return periods calculations.

proj_start_year.label: Projections start year
proj_start_year.info: Starting year defining the projections period for the SPEI and return periods calculations.

proj_end_year.label: Projections end year
proj_end_year.info: Last year defining the projections period for the SPEI and return periods calculations.

growth_season_start.label: Growth season start
growth_season_start.info: First month of the growing season, if specified limits SPEI3 return period analysis to growth season. If set, also Growth season end must be set.

growth_season_end.label: Growth season end
growth_season_end.info: Last month of the growing season, if specified limits SPEI3 return period analysis to growth season. If set, also Growth season start must be set.

return_periods.label: Return periods
return_periods.info: Return periods for which drought intensity, duration and combined intensity and duration will be calculated.

copula_family.label: Copula family
copula_family.info: Copula family to be used, default is gumbel. If left

default_distribution.label: Default distribution
default_distribution.info: Distribution to be used for marginal fitting. Leave blank for autofitting (longer computational times).

exclude_month_events.label: Exclude month events
exclude_month_events.info: If true, excludes drought events of 1 month that can generate noise.
